title: helpful fact_feedback raises trust and records an audit event
description: Proves the exact fact-feedback operation is wired end-to-end: a `helpful` action on a seeded FactId must raise its FactRecordV1 trust score and appear in that fact's typed history.
contract_notes: Deterministic write-path check with no LLM. The harness captures the exact FactId returned during setup and verifies the typed get/history response after feedback.
